chunks: Sufficient is Allah as One, without partner, All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Kafa billahu wahdahu la sharika lahu' in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This passage from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din* articulates the core Shia doctrine of Tawhid, emphasizing Allah’s absolute unity and the perfection of His sensory attributes (Sama’ and Basar) without likening Him to creation (Tanzih). It serves as a foundational creedal statement often cited in theological debates to refute anthropomorphism and affirm the divine omniscience and omnipresence as understood in Imami Shi’ism.
